papers.title_en: Spontaneous brain-wide rotational dynamics constrain cue-evoked behavior
papers.authors: Sihan Chen, Yunlong Xu, Doruk Efe Gökmen, Michel Fruchart, Brent Doiron, Vincenzo Vitelli
papers.evidence: 分析脉冲序列中的旋转动力学；提出旋转成分分析
papers.tldr: 本研究揭示自发全脑旋转动力学约束线索诱发行为。作者开发旋转成分分析（RCA）检测低方差旋转模式，应用于猕猴、人类及小鼠多种神经数据。发现小鼠静息态旋转模式的相位可预测后续拉杆行为；双旋转模式分离准备与任务动态；旋转不可逆性可捕获早期精神病。RCA为检测隐藏非互易动力学提供通用工具。
papers.abstract_en: Uncovering low-dimensional representations of brain-wide neural dynamics and their relationship to behavior remains a central challenge. Here, we show that spontaneous brain-wide rotational dynamics constrain cue-evoked behavior and learning. To systematically establish these findings, we developed a dimensionality-reduction technique called Rotational Component Analysis (RCA) that optimizes the detection of low-variance rotational modes even within individual trials. We applied RCA to motor-cortical spike-train data from monkeys and humans, mouse cortex-wide calcium imaging, and human functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and magnetoencephalography (MEG). In mice, a rotational mode identified from activity recorded at rest predicts cue-evoked behavior: the phase of rotation when a randomly timed cue arrives predicts whether the animal subsequently pulls the lever. We explain this surprisingly strong correlation using both a recurrent neural network (RNN) and a minimal two-dimensional model of response learning, in which the intrinsic rotational mode serves as a dynamical constraint on response and learning. We further identify double-rotation modes containing two centers of rotation that separate preparatory from task dynamics in both mouse and human data. Remarkably, corresponding modes also organize neural dynamics during a non-motor human task, and rotational irreversibility captures early psychosis even when principal component analysis shows no group difference. Our work establishes rotational dynamics as low-dimensional coordinates that constrain how ongoing brain states are converted into behavior. More broadly, RCA provides a versatile tool for detecting hidden nonreciprocal dynamics in biological and physical datasets.

papers.title_en: NeuroAct: Advancing EEG Analysis and Decoding via Dual-Loop Autonomous Research
papers.authors: Wei Xiong, Jiangtong Li, Han Zhao, Linxiao Yang, Jie Li, Changjun Jiang
papers.evidence: 用于BCI中EEG分析与解码的自主研究代理框架
papers.tldr: 针对EEG分析解码中固定流程和奖励驱动搜索难以明确信号结构与干预选择的问题，本文提出NeuroAct双循环自主研究代理框架，内循环基于证据优化候选，外循环提炼跨任务建议。在四类设置中显著提升多项指标，并实现经验复用提升跨任务性能。
papers.abstract_en: EEG analysis and decoding underpin brain-computer interfaces, cognitive assessment, and sleep monitoring. Fixed pipelines and reward-driven search do not explicitly determine how signal structure, representations, predictor behavior, and training dynamics contribute to performance or generalization gaps, leaving intervention choice underdetermined. We introduce NeuroAct, an autonomous research agent framework for EEG analysis and decoding. NeuroAct implements dual-loop autonomous research across EEG foundation models, task-specific predictors, and model combinations. In an inner loop, research, development, and review roles use evidence on signal structure, representations, predictor behavior, and training dynamics to test hypotheses, select analyses or interventions, and refine candidates using performance, stability, and cost feedback. An outer loop distills outcomes into conditional, testable recommendations with task and model conditions, then validates and revises them on subsequent tasks.We evaluate four settings: (A) EEG General Analysis, (B) Cross-task Model Optimization, (C) Single-task Open Research, and (D) Collaborative Prediction. In Setting A, NeuroAct's 80.88 macro-average exceeds BrainAgent's 63.13 by 17.75 points. In Setting B, NeuroAct raises EEGPT's mean balanced accuracy (BA) by 7.34 points and HBN Pearson's (r) from 0.6894 to 0.7362; in Setting C, it improves ADFTD BA by 16.33 points; and in Setting D, it raises Workload BA from 79.69% to 85.02%. Experience reuse raises BCIC-IV-2a BA from 34.66% to 50.81% while reducing LLM tokens by 64.02%, indicating recommendations improve cross-task performance. NeuroAct enables evidence-guided EEG research improved by cross-task experience.

papers.title_en: HP-GSBS: Accelerating greedy state boundary search with reusable interval statistics
papers.evidence: 加速贪婪状态边界搜索，用于识别神经活动模式中的转变
papers.tldr: GSBS通过识别稳定神经活动模式间的转换进行状态分割，但重复候选评估导致大规模分析昂贵。HP-GSBS是一个开源Python包，将搜索重组为可重用区间贡献与相关性统计，并结合流式候选缩减与局部细化减少重复计算，支持CPU、PyTorch CUDA和Triton后端。在七个受控工作负载上实现中位154至1730倍加速，且所有优化执行完整复现原始分割结果。
papers.abstract_en: Greedy State Boundary Search (GSBS) identifies transitions between relatively stable neural activity patterns, but repeated candidate evaluation makes large analyses expensive. HP-GSBS is an open-source Python package that reorganizes the search around reusable interval contributions and correlation statistics. Streaming candidate reduction and local refinement further reduce repeated work; CPU, PyTorch CUDA and Triton backends share sequential segmentation decisions. Across seven controlled workloads with two realizations each, median same-input speedups range from 154 to 1730 times. All 168 optimized executions reproduce original boundaries and selected state counts, with maximum absolute t-distance difference $1.88\times10^{-11}$. Four frozen EEG recordings provide complementary validation, including a complete input-to-segmentation application example. Batch processing, versioned result persistence and optional low-memory execution support recording collections and longer inputs. By removing redundant computation, HP-GSBS makes established neural-state segmentation faster while preserving its scientific outputs.

papers.title_en: Logit Averaging During Training Sets a New State of the Art for Non-Invasive Speech BCI
papers.authors: Miran Özdogan, Gereon Elvers, Michael Bronstein, Oiwi Parker Jones
papers.evidence: 非侵入式语音脑机接口神经解码聚合
papers.tldr: 非侵入性脑机接口受信噪比限制，多试次聚合策略缺乏系统比较。本文首次评估六种聚合范式，发现训练时logit平均在多数设置中表现最佳，并在PNPL音素分类上超冠军17.4个百分点，刷新SOTA。研究确立了聚合为关键设计选择，提供简单有效默认，并质疑联合集成失败机制。
papers.abstract_en: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces are in practice limited by signal-to-noise ratio, and recent state-of-the-art methods address this limitation by aggregating over repeated trials of the same stimulus. Yet multi-trial aggregation has been treated inconsistently across the literature: some work averages brain signals at the model's input, other work averages predictions at the model's output, and neither treats aggregation as an architectural choice in its own right. We provide the first systematic comparison of aggregation strategies for non-invasive neural decoding, evaluating six paradigms (including logit averaging during training and three attention-based variants we introduce) across three datasets, four tasks, and two group sizes. We find that aggregation choice matters substantially: training-time logit averaging, the simplest method we propose, outperforms all others in 6 of 7 settings. On the phoneme classification setting of the 2025 PNPL competition, it sets a new state of the art, significantly outperforming the competition winner by 17.4 absolute percentage points in balanced accuracy. We further draw a theoretical connection between logit averaging and joint ensemble training, which has been shown to underperform independent ensembling in the deep learning literature; our results call into question recent explanations of why joint ensemble training fails. Together, these findings establish multi-trial aggregation as a key design choice for non-invasive neural decoding and identify training-time logit averaging as a simple, effective default.

papers.title_en: Online Preplay and Offline Replay Optimize Action Selection in a Closed-Loop Navigation Model
papers.evidence: 海马预演/重放序列与空间编码
papers.tldr: 海马体重放类型多样但机制功能不明。本研究用脉冲神经网络闭环导航模型，发现任务依赖突触修饰导致不同重放：在线前向重放促捷径发现，离线前向重放巩固最优动作，扩散重放泛化状态-动作映射。单一网络架构可灵活生成多种重放并优化导航。
papers.abstract_en: Hippocampal neurons not only encode the animal's current position, but also generate sequences representing potential future states and past locations. During goal-directed navigation, the represented location sweeps ahead of the animal's location (online forward replay). After such tasks, during rest, neuronal sequences occurring during sharp-wave ripples replay previously explored trajectories (offline forward replay). Following random foraging, however, neuronal sequences resemble Brownian motion, which does not correlate with behavior (diffusive replay). The mechanisms producing such diverse sequences, and their distinct effects on spatial coding and navigation, remain unclear. Here, we address these questions using a closed-loop model of navigation in a two-dimensional open-field environment based on a spiking neuronal network. In our framework, neuronal sequences are generated by a common mechanism driven by background noise and the balance of excitation and inhibition. Different replay modes arise solely from task-dependent synaptic modifications and serve different functions: online forward replay facilitates shortcut discovery, offline forward replay consolidates optimal sequences of actions, and diffusive replay helps in generalizing the action and state map and homogenizing internal connectivity. Together, these results show that a single network architecture can flexibly generate various replay types and clarify how each contributes to optimizing goal-directed navigation behavior.

papers.title_en: Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network for Asymmetric EEG-Eye Movement Emotion Recognition
papers.authors: Peijun Shi, Xiujin Zhu, Zhenguo Lao, Chee-Onn Chow, Wei Ru Wong, Zhen Liu, Xiaobing Jiang
papers.evidence: 基于图网络和蒸馏的脑电情绪识别
papers.tldr: 针对非对称EEG-眼动情绪识别中眼动数据易缺失、现有模型并行融合且单窗口分类的问题，提出上下文感知拓扑蒸馏图网络CTD-GNet。该网络以EEG特征为电极图节点，利用眼动与历史窗口调制图结构，并通过双向蒸馏耦合多模态教师与单窗口EEG学生，在SEED和SEED-IV上取得最高准确率，且在眼动缺失、噪声及跨被试场景下鲁棒性显著。
papers.abstract_en: EEG-eye movement emotion recognition can support mental-health monitoring and adaptive interfaces, but most fusion models treat the two signals as parallel features, classify each window alone and degrade when eye data are lost. We propose the Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network (CTD-GNet), in which EEG features form the nodes of an electrode graph, and eye movements and preceding windows modulate its edges, nodes and readout, the edges through electrode-specific prompts. Bidirectional distillation of the graph, node relations and predictions couples this multimodal teacher with a single-window EEG student, improving the teacher and aligning the two graphs 35-fold. In leave-one-subject-out tests on SEED and SEED-IV against 17 baselines, CTD-GNet has the highest mean accuracy, 84.91% and 76.17%, significantly above 9 and 6 of 13 eye-based baselines after Holm correction, the smallest cross-subject spread among multimodal models and the highest worst-subject accuracy. It is the most accurate model at every rate of missing eye data on SEED-IV, keeps 66.1% on SEED without eye data, more than any EEG-only model, and stays 9.3 and 11.9 points above all single-window fusion models under eye-movement noise of one standard deviation. On film clips unseen in training, it leads on SEED with 77.1%.

papers.title_en: PyGPLA: A Python Package for Generalized Phase Locking Analysis
papers.authors: Amir Khani, Christian Beste, Shervin Safavi
papers.evidence: 用于分析神经元群体协调的spike-LFP耦合软件包
papers.tldr: PyGPLA是一个开源Python包，实现广义相位锁定分析(GPLA)，用于解决高密度电生理记录中传统成对spike-LFP耦合分析面临的统计与计算挑战。该方法将spike触发的LFP相位信息构建为复耦合矩阵并提取低秩模式，从而揭示群体层面的耦合结构、通道与单元贡献及相对相位组织。该包支持多变量耦合估计、解释及分析和替代检验显著性评估，可便捷集成到现有神经数据分析流程。
papers.abstract_en: Spike-field couplings measure the links between neuronal spiking and local field potential (LFP) and provide a tool to study how neural populations coordinate activity across spatial and temporal scales. While modern high-density electrophysiology enables the simultaneous recording of numerous LFP channels and neuronal units, this massive scale poses significant statistical and computational challenges for conventional pairwise coupling analyses. The number of channel-unit comparisons grows rapidly, and a coherent population-level structure can be obscured by high-dimensional coupling matrices. Generalized Phase Locking Analysis (GPLA) addresses this challenge by organizing spike-triggered LFP phase information into a complex coupling matrix and extracting dominant low-rank modes. These modes summarize whether a population is coupled to the field, which channels and units contribute to the coupling, and how their relative phases are organized. Here, we present PyGPLA, an open-source Python package implementing GPLA for high-density electrophysiological recordings. Designed for straightforward integration into existing neural data analysis pipelines, PyGPLA supports multivariate spike-LFP coupling analysis, from coupling estimation and interpretation to significance assessment using analytical and surrogate-based tests.

papers.title_en: HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series
papers.evidence: 不规则时间序列建模方法，可应用于解码神经活动模式
papers.tldr: 针对不规则时间序列需在任意坐标查询且现有方法重复解析表示的问题，论文提出 HiPPO 函数记忆（HiPPO-FM），一个将不规则历史编译为可重用坐标寻址状态的函数记忆注意力算子。它把观察写入固定秩函数空间，通过核平滑 HiPPO 坐标和 Gram 读出直接评估，并用观察支持自注意力实现内容依赖。理论给出误差分解，实验在连续重建、UEA 数据集、真实外推和事件预测上改进强基线，且编码状态可跨查询重用。
papers.abstract_en: Irregular time series require models to answer temporal queries at arbitrary coordinates, yet existing approaches typically retain observation-dependent representations that must be repeatedly resolved for each query. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), a functional-memory attention operator that compiles an irregular history into a reusable coordinate-addressable state. Instead of storing observation-indexed tokens or latent trajectories, HiPPO-FM writes observations into a fixed-rank functional space and performs direct coordinate evaluation through matched functional geometry. Kernel-smoothed HiPPO coordinates and Gram-based readout define a shared write/read mechanism, while observed-support self-attention enables content-dependent representations before compression. We characterize the induced finite-dimensional query space and derive an error decomposition separating functional geometry approximation from learned-memory mismatch. Across continuous-coordinate reconstruction, irregular representation learning, real-world extrapolation, and event-sequence prediction, HiPPO-FM consistently improves strong irregular time-series baselines, achieving strong reconstruction accuracy on Spiral, competitive performance across 20 UEA datasets, improved real-world extrapolation, and superior results on several irregular event benchmarks. After encoding, the compact functional state can be reused across different query sets without reprocessing the observation history.
